rachel: Seeing a wave of TLS verify errors in ap-northeast-1 and eu-west-3 starting 03:42 UTC. Not typical KMS decrypt denies; logs point to certificate chain validation + OCSP fetch failures.

rachel: sample from proxy-log:

rachel: ```proxy-edge-7.log: 2026-06-01T03:42:11Z WARN tls verify failed: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority (CN=svc-edge-ingress)
proxy-edge-7.log: 2026-06-01T03:42:12Z WARN ocsp fetch failed: dial tcp 10.8.0.12:80: i/o timeout```

kevin: any recent keystore/wrap policy changes? or did we flip cipher policy recently?

rachel: We landed a keystore HSM routing change and an IAM condition for GetPublicKey yesterday. Audit shows a Deny on public reads from proxy fetchers: 

rachel: ```iam.audit: 2026-06-01T03:40:02Z DENY method=keystore.GetPublicKey principal=serviceAccount:svc-proxy-fetch@prod reason=iamCondition=false resource=projects/keystore/cryptoKeys/edge-key/versions/7```

sam: That would block public key retrieval; but OCSP timeouts suggest egress or OCSP responder reachability too. Any network ACL changes?

kevin: ops asks: KMS Deny spike?

audit-bot: KMS Deny rate for GetPublicKey: 54 in 4m (threshold 8). Also showing several HSM backend timeouts: backend.hsm.latency > 2s for 120s window.

devops-bot: Notified netops. Checked egress-paths to OCSP responders; no recent ACL changes. Some NAT gateway errors reported in ap-northeast-1 during the window.

rachel: So combined failure mode: proxies couldn't fetch public keys due to IAM condition, rotator couldn't prime caches because HSM latency + NAT errors were causing retries to fail -> proxies served stale certs and OCSP stapling failed.

kevin: Immediate actions: 1) revert the GetPublicKey condition (fast), 2) prime public key caches and re-run OCSP recache job, 3) restart a small proxy canary to pick up fresh certs. I'll flip the IAM change now.

kevin: Revert command run at 03:46 UTC. Change-id=iam-revert-37123.

certbot: Automated: pub-recache job queued job=pubrec-37123-03-47. Will attempt fetch and prime cache if IAM allows.

audit-bot: After revert, KMS Deny count dropped to 2 in 5m. HSM latency persisted briefly but improved after 03:50.

rachel: After public recache and canary restart, handshake error rate back to baseline by 03:54 UTC. OCSP stapling healthy.

sam: Follow-ups: 1) CI coverage for conditioned GetPublicKey role + simulated NAT egress failures, 2) ensure IAM audit includes impersonation_chain and effective principal, 3) add runbook entry: if (GetPublicKey denies spike) && (ocsp/tls verify spike) => consider immediate IAM revert + public recache.

kevin: Also propose an automation: detect (KMS Deny for GetPublicKey > 20/min) AND (tls_verify_fail_rate > 5%) in region -> open a guided revert with one-click rollback that requires 2 approvers within 10m. I'll draft the PR.

rachel: Security note: HSM latency during key unwrap/lookup is an additional brittle axis. We should add a pre-rollout canary that validates both IAM read success and HSM tail latency < 1s before enabling conditioned binds.

devops-bot: NAT gateway team acknowledged transient errors in ap-northeast-1 at 03:41-03:49 UTC. Will post RCA.

certbot: pub-recache job pubrec-37123-03-47 completed: primed 8/8 proxies in ap-northeast-1 and 6/6 in eu-west-3. status=success.

kevin: Filing follow-ups: SEC-2026-112 (CI tests + audit fields), OPS-2026-410 (guided IAM revert automation), INFRA-2026-221 (HSM latency SLAs and preflight).

rachel: I'll assemble a short incident note and link PM doc. Thanks all.

devops-bot: Incident INC-20260601-getpub-hsm-nat created. Severity: P2. Link: https://internal.redwood/pm/INC-20260601-getpub-hsm-nat
